title: Print the source-size inventory so host test evidence carries per-file line counts
outcome: Print the source-size inventory so host test evidence carries per-file line counts
acceptance: The output is bounded and deterministic (sorted paths), and the failing path still lists every oversized file
docs/development.md names the exact command hosts run for the file-size evidence; the full quality gates pass

tests/source_file_size.rs prints one line per guarded file (path and physical line count, with the limit) when it passes, visible with `cargo test --test source_file_size -- --nocapture`, so a host-observed run of that command carries the per-file counts the file-size split criteria ask for

completion.summary: The source-size test prints one line per guarded file, sorted by path across families, as "PATH: N physical lines (limit 2499)". It refuses a file guarded by two families and still names every oversized file. docs/development.md names `cargo test --test source_file_size -- --nocapture` as the host evidence command. Full gates passed; the Codex and Claude reviews are clean. Committed as be8bd18, pushed, and installed as build b1984ecec780. Follow-up w-c21e64736e39 adds per-family runs so one family's inventory fits the evidence summary.
